description: A production control manager must decide how to disposition 900 aluminum blanks from Cell 2 after labels from two revisions were mixed, and must finalize the relabeling, shipment, and release controls with input from quality, maintenance, logistics, and compliance.

shared_context.S1: Cell 2 is holding 900 aluminum blanks because labels from two drawing revisions were mixed during a labeling run.
shared_context.S2: The blanks are physically segregated from released inventory and production is paused until the disposition is approved.
shared_context.S3: Mara has authority to approve the disposition, recovery work, and shipment plan.
shared_context.S4: At the daily disposition huddle, Mara asks quality, maintenance, logistics, and product compliance for relevant findings before recording the plan.

PF1.text: Eli completed a piece-by-piece traceability audit this morning: exactly 640 blanks can be positively matched to revision C and pass the dimensional screen, while exactly 260 cannot be matched to a revision and must be scrapped under the traceability procedure; he has not uploaded the audit to the shared quality system yet.

PF2.text: Sonia inspected the label printer and confirmed that its revision-selection firmware requires a patch followed by verification before any relabeling; the patch and verification will take exactly 90 minutes, and she has not entered the work order because the printer was still under troubleshooting.

PF3.text: Victor confirmed with the customer and carrier that exactly 640 revision-C blanks can be collected Friday at 15:00 on exactly 2 pallets if the shipping documents are transmitted by Friday at 12:00; he has not entered the confirmation in the dispatch system because the customer amended the pickup request this morning.

PF4.text: Nadia's compliance review found that revision-C blanks require one serialized two-dimensional code per piece and a documented scan verification before release; the requirement is in a newly issued customer addendum that has not yet been added to the local release checklist.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly 640 revision-C blanks must be released.
Exactly 260 untraceable blanks must be scrapped.
The relabeling plan must reserve exactly 90 minutes for the printer patch and verification.
A printer patch and verification work order must be committed.
The 640 released blanks must be scheduled for pickup Friday at 15:00 on exactly 2 pallets.
Shipping documents must be committed for transmission by Friday at 12:00.
Every released blank must receive a serialized two-dimensional label.
A documented scan verification must be required before release.
The quality audit finding must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C4: any(c['target'] == 'Sonia' and 'work order' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['target'] == 'Victor' and 'shipping documents' in c['detail'] and ('Friday 12:00' in c['detail'] or 'Friday at 12:00' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The audit changes the disposition from an unspecified hold to exactly 640 revision-C blanks released and exactly 260 untraceable blanks scrapped.
The printer assessment changes the recovery schedule to exactly 90 minutes of patch-and-verification downtime and adds the required work-order commitment.
The carrier confirmation changes shipment timing to Friday at 15:00 on exactly 2 pallets and creates the Friday 12:00 document-transmission commitment.
The customer addendum changes release controls to serialized two-dimensional labels on every piece and documented scan verification before release.
